_comment: Per-rule triage overrides applied by tools/automation_report.py. The keyword heuristic labels a rule 'mechanically-automatable' from its wording; these overrides correct that with hands-on review. A rule is only mechanically-automatable if it is checkable against TODAY's IR. Rules needing a new authoring/IR field are 'needs-ir-extension' (a grammar RFC); rules another gate already covers are 'already-enforced'/'enforced-elsewhere'; inherently semantic ones are 'human-judgment'. Each carries a reason.

action.compose.order.reason: No IR structure for inter-action ordering/dependencies; needs an action-composition grammar.

action.compose.saga.reason: No saga construct (forward actions / compensations / durable state) in the IR.

action.concurrency.version.reason: IR has no optimistic version/comparison-token field; valid models declare concurrency:optimistic without one, so a check would false-positive.

action.destructive.recovery.reason: IR has no recovery/rollback/backup/irreversibility field on actions.

action.destructive.retention.reason: IR has no retention / legal-hold / archival declaration.

action.destructive.scope.reason: IR has no evaluated-target-count / preview field for destructive set actions.

action.device.safety.reason: No device/control-command construct (capability / interlock / permissive) in the IR.

action.record.create-input.reason: Action IR carries no field-level input specification to check required-field coverage against the target entity.

action.record.create-readonly.reason: Action IR does not enumerate client-assigned fields, so they cannot be compared to read-only/generated attributes.

action.record.delete-policy.reason: IR has no delete-behavior field (hard-delete / soft-delete / archive / tombstone).

action.record.postcondition.reason: Postconditions are authorable but not consistently authored; better realized as a recommended coverage obligation than a validity error.

action.retry.bound.reason: Boundedness is already schema-enforced (retry is int>=0); the backoff-policy requirement needs a backoff field the IR lacks.

action.set.cascade.reason: IR has no cascade-bound field, and bulk-update is a used operation, so a blanket check would false-positive on valid models.

action.transaction.required.reason: Which invariants REQUIRE atomicity is not derivable from the IR; needs an explicit requires-transaction declaration.

integration.mapping.coverage.reason: IR integration profile has no field-level source->target mapping structure to check coverage against.

kcf.extension.point.reason: No extension-point registry in the IR to validate extensions against.

stack.governance.audit.reason: Advisory (SHOULD); no audit/evidence-path field on actions in the IR.

stack.name.visibility.reason: IR has no export/visibility metadata to enforce scoped access.

stack.graph.cycle-policy.reason: Specific acyclic graphs ARE enforced (lineage.cycle, organization.hierarchy.acyclic); a general 'declared acyclic' policy would need an IR flag.

kcf.profile.prohibited.reason: kcf.profile.pattern-prohibited enforces prohibited PATTERNS; prohibiting arbitrary constructs needs a prohibited-construct registry the IR lacks.

action.destructive.explicit.reason: delete/bulk-delete/replace are in COMMANDS, so action.invoke.effect-context already requires effect==command (explicit classification).

action.idempotency.create.reason: effect==command already requires an idempotency classification via action.contract.incomplete.

action.invoke.authorization.reason: effect==command already requires authorization via stack.security.authorization; the caller's runtime authorization is an external fact, not IR-checkable.

action.set.bulk-upsert.reason: bulk-upsert is a SET_MUTATION, covered by action.set.selection-required + action.set.atomicity + action.set.concurrency.

action.set.synchronize.reason: synchronize is a SET_MUTATION, covered by the same set-mutation rules.

stack.ownership.boundary.reason: Grammar-stack ownership is enforced by tools/lint_stack.py + validate_stack.py + module-lock, not the per-model analyzer.

action.set.invariants.reason: Whether cross-record invariants hold at the declared atomicity boundary is a semantic property, not a structural check.

kcf.concept.provenance.reason: Derived-ness in KCF is expressed THROUGH provenance fields (extractionMethod/confidence); there is no clean IR signal for 'derived but unprovenanced'. Assertion-level provenance IS automated (knowledge.assertion.provenance).

kcf.relationship.classification.reason: Keeping classification and identity 'distinct' is a modeling-judgment property with no structural signature.
